summary: Address code smell: shotgun surgery commands in todo2code gate

delivery.outcome: Remove the code2llm 'Shotgun Surgery: commands' report for src/koru/queue/todo2code_gate.py (PLF-043) by stopping the rebinding of the generic local name 'commands' across the verify-gate pipeline: infer_project_verify_commands returns the first detector hit through a single walrus 'declared' binding, _verify_from_koru_yaml names its raw koru.yaml extraction 'declared_commands', infer_project_verify_command and resolve_project_verify_commands name their pipeline value 'gates', and _compose_wrapped_commands selects the effective gate list once with the pure expression 'gates = container_commands or commands' instead of conditionally overwriting its parameter. No function in the module assigns or mutates a variable named 'commands' anymore, so the detector's same-file mutation count for that name drops from 5 functions to 0. Behavior is unchanged: detector precedence, 'sh -lc' wrapping, docker-compose wrapping and every error string are byte-identical. tests/test_todo2code_autonomous_gate.py adds test_docker_project_wraps_host_gates_when_container_declares_none pinning the previously untested compose fallback branch (no container commands declared -> host gates are wrapped).
nonGoals: Changing detector precedence, produced command lists, wrapping or any error message
Renaming the public infer_project_verify_commands / infer_project_verify_command / resolve_project_verify_commands signatures that tests and ticket_templates.py rely on
Extracting a module or moving the gate (no new patch targets, facade late-binding untouched)
Touching todo2code_support.py or any other queue-module smell

architecture.decision: The reported smell is generic-name coincidence inside one pipeline file: five independent locals all named 'commands' for different stages of verify-gate resolution (raw koru.yaml strings, detector hits, resolved gates, container-overridden gates). The remediation gives each stage local a stage-accurate name and turns the only conditional rebinding (parameter overwrite in _compose_wrapped_commands) into one pure selection expression, keeping command-list construction return-expression based like the ticket-251/252 lanes. No module extraction is needed (intra-file naming), so there are no new patch targets and the import surface is unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Revert the single ticket commit to restore the five 'commands' locals.

validation.evidence: The grep finds no assignment or mutating method call on a variable named 'commands'; the only remaining uses are read-only (parameter reads and the yaml key lookup).
All existing gate pins (detector precedence, multi-command koru.yaml, docker refusal, container-command override) plus the new compose-fallback test pass.

commands: python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_todo2code_ticket_text.py tests/test_todo2code_modules.py tests/test_todo2code_discovery.py
validation.evidence: Neighboring todo2code suites that consume ticket_templates/gate hydration stay green.
Governance gate reports 0 errors from the ticket worktree.
